discrepancies.description: Role A added src/btc_quant_agent/strategy_research/__init__.py outside the allowed src/btc_quant_agent/strategy_research/r3_overnight/** prefix.
Role A reported reported_row_count=2933280 instead of the actual 2,934,720 rows in data_manifest.json (omitting 1,440 minutes = 1 leap day).

In _stage_5_due_entries at t0, Role A creates self.positions[sym] = Position(..., max_hold_ms=candidate_max_hold_ms) AND queues VirtualFill(available_at_ms=t0+60_000). At t0+60_000, _stage_1_available_messages unconditionally overwrites self.positions[fill.symbol] with a new Position(..., max_hold_ms=0). Consequently: (a) any surviving trade has max_hold_ms reset to 0 at t0+60s, causing _stage_6_intraminute_protection (L614: open_time_ms + 60_000 >= pos.entry_time_ms + pos.max_hold_ms) to immediately trigger ExitReason.EXPIRY after 2 minutes instead of 4h/12h and wiping out any Stage 7 funding charged at t0; (b) any trade that already closed via same-minute SL/TP at t0 is resurrected as a zombie position at t0+60s and closes a second time.

discrepancies.specification_reference: V06_G2_R3_METHOD_R1_1_CONTROLLER_L2_ACCEPTANCE.md (Per-Candidate Non-Overlapping Isolated Virtual Books & Family 2 Closed Retest State)
discrepancies.description: ReplayEngine shares a single SignalGenerator instance across all 8 candidates while SignalGenerator._active_breakouts is keyed by (symbol, candidate.direction) without candidate.id. Under CostScenario.BASE, CLOSED_RETEST_LONG_04H and CLOSED_RETEST_LONG_12H both call evaluate_hourly_decision in the same hourly loop: on the breakout hour, 04H registers _active_breakouts[(sym, LONG)], and 12H (evaluated microseconds later for the same hour) sees the active breakout, treats the breakout hour itself as retest bar #1 (bars_since_breakout += 1), and on confirmation 04H consumes _consumed_retest_events so 12H never receives the confirmation signal.

discrepancies.specification_reference: V06_G2_R3_METHOD_R1_1_CONTROLLER_L2_ACCEPTANCE.md (Family 2 Closed Retest Touch Zone & Initial Stop Placement)
discrepancies.description: For LONG retest confirmation, R1.1 requires low in [B - 0.25*ATR_b, B + 0.25*ATR_b], whereas Role A checks range overlap (low <= B + 0.25*ATR_b and high >= B - 0.25*ATR_b), admitting deep wicks below B - 0.25*ATR_b. In addition, min(breakout.intermediate_lows) (L306) and max(breakout.intermediate_highs) (L334) omit breakout.breakout_low and breakout.breakout_high from the breakout-through-confirmation stop extremum.

Role A updates self.last_available_marks inside _stage_2_account_risk instead of _stage_1_available_messages, and stores mbar.timestamp_ms (bar open time) instead of mbar.close_ms (bar close time) for the 120s mark staleness calculation.

discrepancies.specification_reference: V06_G2_R3_METHOD_R1_1_CONTROLLER_L2_ACCEPTANCE.md (4h Cooldown From ceil_to_minute(economic_exit_at) & Structural Continuation 4h Dedup)
discrepancies.description: Stage 1 sets cooldown_until_ms = open_time_ms + COOLDOWN_DURATION_MS at acknowledgment time rather than ceil_to_minute(economic_exit_at) + 4h, compares signal.decision_time_ms < cooldown_until_ms instead of signal.available_at_ms, and ReplayEngine.run_simulation never passes last_exit_time_ms or last_entry_4h_time_ms to SignalGenerator.evaluate_hourly_decision, bypassing the Structural Continuation 4h-bar deduplication rule.

discrepancies.specification_reference: V06_G2_R3_METHOD_R1_1_CONTROLLER_L2_ACCEPTANCE.md (Exit Reserve Commitment c_exit = 1.10 * price * (fee + friction) + tick_size)
discrepancies.description: _stage_5_due_entries computes Position.cost_commitment_exit_usdt without adding sym_filter.tick_size * order.quantity and releases pending commitments in _stage_5_due_entries without retaining active position exit/funding reserves in cost_commitment_o / funding_reserve_rf.
